entities.question: What is the title of the work?

content_blocks.label: body_text
content_blocks.text: In the quiet town of Millbrook, a local hero has been quietly saving lives for over a decade. Dr. Emma Watson, a retired nurse, has dedicated herself to helping the homeless and the sick without any recognition. Every weekend, she can be found at the local shelter, providing medical care and emotional support. Her kindness and selflessness have inspired countless residents, yet her name remains unknown to most. This week, The Daily Globe seeks to shine a light on this unsung hero and the impact she has had on the community.
